# Amazon MWAA tokens and execution

**Status: future extensions.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Environment configuration records and tags are implemented. Tokens, Airflow APIs and actual execution require a separate runtime contract.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] `CreateWebLoginToken`
- [ ] `CreateCliToken`
- [ ] `InvokeRestApi`
- [ ] Airflow DAG/task execution, scheduler/worker/webserver lifecycle and readiness
- [ ] Real URLs/endpoints, credentials, log and metrics delivery
- [ ] Advanced artifacts, configuration, encryption and network configuration updates
